notes: ruling needed: the saying is Yunus's own account of meeting Ja'far in Medina, where the Imam speaks and acts inside the scene (rule 11); the chain is written to Yunus, but whether the Imam is its source is not settled by the text
«أبي محمد أخي يونس بن يعقوب» is written with the kunya as the surface; «أخي يونس بن يعقوب» describes him and is not a second link
«أخيه يونس» is the bare name «يونس» (second occurrence in the text)
